summary_zh: 前文围绕Tata发布小红书创作者10周年纪念视频，称其是早期头部博主并肯定长期积累；收录帖把个人成长叙事与#LoveActuallyS5、BKTT关联，偏情感曝光而非商品、价格或配送。后续同作者继续引用她关于独居、做饭和厨房多一人的内容，无他人回应。上下文显示情绪正向、真实性基于公开视频与转述，传播价值偏粉丝圈层。

posts.text:
#LoveActuallyS5 #bktt

Tata posted a video to commemorate her 10-year anniversary as a creator on XHS. 

For context, she was one of the OG top 3 influencers on Xiaohongshu back in the early days. Seeing how she built her name and reputation organically from the very beginning, through 10 years of hard work and consistency, is genuinely so inspiring and touching. She also  included BKTT as part of this 10 year journey makes it even more special 🥹❤️

posts.translation_zh:
#LoveActuallyS5 #bktt

Tata 发布了一条视频，纪念她在 XHS 作为创作者的 10 周年。

补充一下背景，她是小红书早期元老级头部 3 大博主之一。看到她从一开始就凭借 10 年的努力与坚持，自然而然地建立起自己的名字和声誉，真的非常鼓舞人心，也很令人感动。她还把 BKTT 也纳入了这 10 年旅程的一部分，让这一切变得更加特别 🥹❤️

Tata: I was living well and taking life seriously. Even when I was living alone, I would make myself an exquisite dinner and together with everyone, I unlocked so many different cuisines. And now there’s another person in the kitchen. Countless ordinary fragments of everyday life, countless times when food healed the heart
